privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.lastUpdated: Last updated 26 June 2026 · ATG Concordia (Pvt) Ltd
privacyPage.whoWeAreText: ATG Concordia (Pvt) Ltd operates ATG Apply, a human-run job application service based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
privacyPage.whatWeCollectText: To submit your applications we collect: contact details, visa status, and education and employment history.
privacyPage.retentionText: We retain your records for 24 months after your last activity.
privacyPage.deletionText: You can request deletion of your data at any time via privacy@atgconcordia.com.
privacyPage.sensitiveDataText: Sensitive credentials are never passed to third-party AI tools.
privacyPage.noScrapingText: Every application is prepared and submitted by a trained member of our team.
privacyPage.refundsText: Transaction data is retained for the accounting purposes required by law.
privacyPage.commitmentText: We aim to add your first recommended jobs within 3 working days.
privacyPage.rightsText: You can access, correct, export or delete your data at any time.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.lastUpdated: Last updated 26 June 2026 · ATG Concordia (Pvt) Ltd
termsPage.sec1Text: ATG Apply is a service that researches roles, prepares tailored applications, and submits them with your approval.
termsPage.sec2Text: We do not guarantee interviews or job offers. Our obligation is to apply a professional standard of care.
termsPage.sec3Text: The trial includes 2 free applications. Paid packages add applications to your balance.
termsPage.sec4Text: Payment is manual (bank transfer or Wise). Your balance is activated once payment is received.
termsPage.sec5Text: You can request a refund within 14 days for any unused applications.
termsPage.sec6Text: If something goes wrong, contact support@atgconcordia.com. We aim to resolve disputes within 7 working days.
termsPage.sec7Text: You confirm the information you provide is accurate and you authorise us to apply on your behalf.
termsPage.sec8Text: Fraudulent use may result in suspension of the service.
